CustomField.label: Guest Retention (Months)
CustomField.description: GDPR retention: guests with no stay ending within this many months are handled by the weekly retention job (see Guest Retention Mode). Blank or below 1 = 36. Confirm the period with your legal adviser. Edit on the org-level PMS Settings record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Months without a stay before a guest is due for retention handling. Default 36.
